title: Xigodlho xa Nghilazi ya Xivoni
intro: Anakanya tiko ra le kule leri nga ni rifuwo ni ku vangama laha dyambu ri gandzeriwaka ematshan’weni ya Muvumbi wa rona. Ku fika papila leri rhwaleke xirhambo lexi nga honisiwiki, naswona riendzo ri sungula ri kongoma ehubyeni leyikulu ku tlula rin’wana ni rin’wana leri voniweke khale. Kwalaho, ku tikhoma ku ta paluxiwa hi fuloro leyi kanganyisaka mahlo, naswona nkarhinyana wa ku va erivaleni wu ta cinca hinkwaswo.
clues: Ndzi fume tiko leri humelelaka leri vanhu va rona a va nkhinsama edyambyini ematshan’weni ya Allah.
Ndzi amukele papila ra xiyimo xa le henhla leri ndzi vitaneke leswaku ndzi nga titlakusi kambe ndzi ta ndzi titsongahata eka Allah.
Ndzi burisanile na huvo ya mina kutani ndzi hlawula vudiplomasi ku sungula, ndzi rhumela nyiko ku kambela loyi a rhumeleke.
Ndzi tile eSulayman, naswona xiluvelo xa mina n’wini xi nyikeriwile eka mina ndzi tifihla leswaku ndzi ringeta ku tiviwa ka mina.
Ndzi nghene exigodlhweni lexi tlakukeke lexi fuloro ya xona ya nghilazi leyi rhetaka ndzi teke xihoxo xa leswaku i mati lama dzimeke.
Ndzi tivise ku titsongahata ka mina na Sulayman eka Allah, Hosi ya misava.

identity.label: Xana Ndzi mani?
options: Sesi wa Musa
Nsati wa Abu Lahab
Nsati wa Nuh
Bilqis, Mufumi wa le Saba
Zulaikha, Nsati wa Al-Aziz

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku mitiwa hi nhlampfi leyikulu evuentweni bya lwandle
Ku hlaseriwa hi malembe yo tala a ri karhi a vabya ni ku lahlekeriwa hi ndyangu
U lerisiwe ku endla gandzelo hi n’wana la rhandzekaka enorhweni
Ku ringiwa hi xiluvelo lexi fihliweke ni xigodlho xa nghilazi
Ku lahleriwa endzilweni lowu pfurhaka hikwalaho ko tshova swifaniso
trial.answer: Ku ringiwa hi xiluvelo lexi fihliweke ni xigodlho xa nghilazi

location.label: Xiphemu xa Nkoka
options: Areka yi ake ehenhla ka mati
Bako ra vutumbelo ra lava etleleke
Xigodlho xa kristala (Sarh) .
Nambu wa Nayili hi nkarhi wa ku rhurha
Ndzilo lowu lunghiseleriweke hi vagandzeri va swifaniso

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Ndzi mitiwe hi misava hi xuma xa mina
U tshame a nga pfumeli naswona u lovisiwile ni vanhu va mina
Ku titsongahata na Sulayman eka Allah, Hosi ya misava
Ku nwela elwandle loko a ri karhi a hlongorisa vapfumeri
U hundzuriwile ribye hikwalaho ko tlula Savata
outcome.answer: Ku titsongahata na Sulayman eka Allah, Hosi ya misava

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
